summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes opaque obfuscated payload on install
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then invokes the locally shipped math_init.js under that runtime via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB @bun-cjs bundle with hex-numeric identifiers, a rotated string/constant array (n7gIxM), an array-rotation decoder (WV8StW), and a string decoder (hc1jfK9), giving no source-level readability. The advertised purpose per README/package.json is a trivial 'Hello <name>' TypeScript library — Bun, native code, and any 'math_init' component are undocumented. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (fetching a second runtime specifically to execute opaque bundled bytes that mismatch the package's stated purpose) fires automatically on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
